description: lowTEMP4districtheat simulates district-heating pressures and temperatures with optional decentralised feeders. It includes data preparation, soft sensors, gap filling and examples for low-temperature network studies. The provider is 4wardEnergyResearch (repository owner). Coverage: The model is configured for individual heat networks. Input measurement coverage, periods and numerical resolution vary with each case. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The repository identifies GPL version 3. Input data and third-party dependencies retain their own conditions. Limitations: Gap-filled values are estimates, not measurements. The project description does not establish independent reuse, maintenance or accuracy under every missing-data pattern. For simulation it supports investigation of lower-temperature heat-network operation. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
